desc:
Welcome to Merge A Keycap!

Buy keycaps, merge them into rarer ones and build the richest rack in the server!

How to Play:
🛒 Buy keycaps on the glowing pads
✨ Merge 3 of the same keycap into a better one
🖱️ Your keycaps pump out Clicks into your pit
🎯 Deposit your Clicks and watch them bounce for up to 77x!
💵 Collect your Cash and buy even better keycaps
🔁 Rebirth for a permanent cash boost
📖 Discover all 50 keycaps in the Index

🐉 Dragon, Galaxy, Phoenix, Legend... the rarer the keycap, the crazier the Clicks!
🧰 Chests drop rare keycaps, diamond Clicks give gems for upgrades
👥 +30% boost for every friend in your server
💤 Your keycaps keep earning while you're away
🎁 Like the game & join the group for FREE money every 10 minutes!

🎮 Desktop, Console, Mobile and Tablet
